title: TSMC Board of Directors Meeting Resolutions
gist: TSMC's board approved Q2 2026 results of NT$1,270.38 billion revenue and NT$706.56 billion net income (diluted EPS NT$27.25), a NT$7.0 per share quarterly dividend now optionally payable in US dollars to foreign holders, capital appropriations of approximately US$29.44 billion for advanced capacity, advanced packaging and fab construction, and a share subscription of up to 282 billion yen in a new image-sensor joint venture with Sony Semiconductor Solutions.

insights.claim: TSMC reported second quarter 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$1,270.38 billion with net income of NT$706.56 billion and diluted earnings per share of NT$27.25.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Hard quarterly baseline for TSMC earnings models and for read-through to the whole foundry and AI supply chain.
insights.quote: Second quarter consolidated revenue was NT$1,270.38 billion and net income was NT$706.56 billion, with diluted earnings per share of NT$27.25.
insights.locator: Approved the 2026 second quarter Business Report

insights.claim: TSMC's reported second quarter 2026 net income of NT$706.56 billion on NT$1,270.38 billion of revenue implies a net margin above 55%, an extraordinary profitability level for a capital-intensive manufacturer.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Margin at this level signals near-monopoly pricing power at the leading edge — the key variable to watch for any competitive erosion from Intel or Samsung.
insights.locator: Approved the 2026 second quarter Business Report

themes.theme: Capex commitment and where it goes

insights.claim: TSMC's board approved capital appropriations of approximately US$29,442.50 million to meet long-term capacity plans based on market demand forecasts and its technology development roadmap.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: A near-$30 billion single-meeting appropriation is a direct order-book signal for ASML, Applied Materials, Lam, TEL and construction suppliers.
insights.quote: the Board approved capital appropriations of approximately US$29,442.50 million

insights.claim: The approved TSMC capital appropriations are allocated across three named purposes: installation and upgrade of advanced technology capacity; installation and upgrade of advanced packaging plus mature and specialty capacity; and fab construction with fab facility systems.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Advanced packaging is called out alongside leading-edge logic, confirming CoWoS-class capacity remains a funded priority, not an afterthought.
insights.quote: 1) Installation and upgrade of advanced technology capacity; 2) Installation and upgrade of advanced packaging, mature and/or specialty technology capacity; 3) Fab construction, and installation of fab facility systems.

insights.claim: TSMC frames its capacity appropriations as driven by market demand forecasts and its own technology roadmap rather than by opportunistic response, indicating a planned multi-year build rather than a reactive surge.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Suggests capex durability through cycle noise — a supportive datapoint for semicap equipment revenue visibility.

insights.claim: TSMC's board approved a NT$7.0 per share cash dividend for the second quarter of 2026, with a December 16, 2026 record date, a December 10, 2026 ex-dividend date, and payment on January 7, 2027.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Concrete dates for dividend capture and for modeling TSMC's cash return alongside its near-$30 billion appropriation.
insights.locator: Approved the distribution of a NT$7.0 per share

insights.claim: Starting with this distribution, TSMC will offer foreign shareholders investing under Taiwan's Regulations Governing Investment in Securities by Overseas Compatriots and Foreign Nationals the option to receive cash dividends in U.S. dollars, following amended Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission rules.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Removes an NTD conversion friction for foreign holders — a small structural positive for foreign ownership of Taiwanese equities generally.
insights.quote: provide foreign shareholders who invest under the “Regulations Governing Investment in Securities by Overseas Compatriots and Foreign Nationals” with the option to receive cash dividends in U.S. dollars
insights.locator: Furthermore, pursuant to the amended regulations

insights.claim: TSMC's shareholders' register will be closed for five days prior to the record date, from December 12 through December 16, 2026, as required by Article 165 of Taiwan's Company Law.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: A hard transfer-registration blackout window that constrains settlement timing for anyone repositioning around the dividend.

insights.claim: Both the ex-dividend date and the record date for TSMC American Depositary Shares are December 10, 2026, differing from the December 16 record date applicable to common shares in Taiwan.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: ADS holders face a different record date than local holders — a detail that matters for cross-listing arbitrage and dividend capture.
insights.locator: The ex-dividend date and the record date

insights.claim: TSMC's board formally approved forming a joint venture with Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation for developing and manufacturing next-generation image sensors, authorizing a share subscription of not more than 282 billion Japanese yen.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Board-level authorization with a hard yen cap converts the announced Sony venture into a committed, bounded obligation on TSMC's balance sheet.
insights.quote: the subscription for shares in the joint venture of not more than 282 billion Japanese yen
insights.locator: Approved the formation of a new joint venture

insights.claim: TSMC's image-sensor joint venture commitment of up to 282 billion yen is small relative to the roughly US$29.4 billion of capacity appropriations approved at the same board meeting, indicating the Sony deal is a strategic option rather than a core capital allocation.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Sizes the Sony venture correctly: meaningful for Japan positioning, immaterial to TSMC's earnings trajectory versus leading-edge capex.
insights.locator: Approved the formation of a new joint venture
